$comment: KG projection contract freeze v1 (plan 8261645, Track D / package D3).
Freezes, BEFORE any seeding: (a) which authority owns which section,
(b) the relation vocabulary, (c) the provenance every node and edge must
carry. Seeding is explicitly out of scope for this decomposition; this file
is the gate a later seeding plan must pass.
Contract-of-record surfaces are the typespec/v1 contracts; the freeze does
not create a new contract, it pins the existing ones.

projection_tables: graph_entities (section, entity_id, name, entity_type, status, description, properties, source_file)
graph_edges (source_section, source_id, relation_type, target_section, target_id, properties, resolution)

ownership.$rule: One owner per section. A section without an owner may not be seeded. Revised ownership is a new freeze_version.

resolution.may_not: let a projection read be treated as authority

shrapnel.may_not: promote an EAV value to authority, or claim Resolution identity

aegis.may_not: let an Aegis invariant become a Conduit gate

keychains.may_not: be read back as operational authority; may not seed graph rows itself

peb.may_not: be changed by this decomposition — activation is frozen (0 changes allowed)

operator.may_not: be inferred from any automated artifact

sections.$rule: Canonical sections are seeded by the rebuild. Non-canonical sections (work_requests, plans) are cache/eviction surfaces and must NOT be seeded as authority — knowledge-mcp purge_section is their canonical eviction path.

non_canonical.reason: live cache of resolution/work_request; never seeded as authority
live cache of conduit plans; never seeded as authority

relations.$rule: A relation_type outside this vocabulary is a hard seed failure. The vocabulary is copied from schemas/decision-b-freeze/relation-vocabulary-map.json and must stay byte-equal to its canonical_vocabulary keys.

frozen_backbone.meaning: Fact asserts content about a subject.
Node provides evidence for a claim.

governed_general.meaning: Cross-entity pointer with no stronger claim; default for field refs. Never implies hierarchy, membership or generation.
Source specifies the schema/contract of target.
Source generatively yields target; only with subject/object evidence.

relations.precedence: frozen_backbone > governed_general; never use a general term where a backbone term is evidenced

provenance.$rule: Every seeded node and edge must carry all required fields. Missing provenance is a seed failure, not a warning.
provenance.temporal_rule: valid_from/valid_until (valid time) and recorded_at (record time) are separate. A projection that collapses them into one timestamp is invalid.
provenance.fingerprint_rule: the seeded node set must be reproducible: same sources + same freeze_version => same rows (modulo recorded_at).

seed_gate.$rule: All checks must pass before any seeding plan runs. This decomposition does not run them.

checks.check: sha256 of each artifact listed in schemas/decision-b-freeze/FREEZE-MANIFEST.json matches
relations.frozen_backbone + relations.governed_general keys == canonical_vocabulary keys in schemas/decision-b-freeze/relation-vocabulary-map.json
every canonical section resolves to exactly one owner in this file
no row targets section in sections.non_canonical
every JSONB column feeding a seeded node/edge has a class in schemas/convergence/resolution-jsonb-classification.v1.json

stop_condition: Freeze published. No seeding, no graph writes, no ownership reassignment. A seeding plan must cite this freeze_version and pass seed_gate before writing a row.
